label: Town of Williston
header:
# Town of Williston municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 27; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 171 (Town of Williston): sec. 14: the Selectboard is one of the town's elective offices

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): names Ellie Beckett, Greta D'Agostino (Vice Chair), Mckew Devitt, Jeanne Jensen, and Ted Kenney (Chair)

Town of Williston, 2025 Annual Town Report: 'Listing of Town and School District Elected Officials' and 'List of Candidates for Town and School Officials to be voted on March 3, 2026': the March 3, 2026 ballot listed Jeanne Jensen (three-year term) and McKew Devitt (two-year term) as the sole candidates; the library trustee minutes of June 15, 2026 record all five members (Kenney, D'Agostino, Beckett, Jensen, Devitt) in attendance. Mike Isham has departed
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 171 (Town of Williston): sec. 14: the Town Clerk is an elective office with a three-year term
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Sarah Mason as Williston's Town Clerk

Town of Williston, 2025 Annual Town Report: 'Listing of Town and School District Elected Officials' and 'List of Candidates for Town and School Officials to be voted on March 3, 2026': the March 3, 2026 ballot listed Sarah Mason as the sole candidate for Town Clerk (three-year term)
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 171 (Town of Williston): sec. 14: the Moderator is one of the town's elective offices

Town of Williston, 2025 Annual Town Report, minutes of the March 2025 annual meeting: 'Christopher D. Roy was unanimously elected Moderator for the ensuing year.' The office is filled from the floor at the annual meeting (it is not on the March 3, 2026 ballot list) and the 2026 outcome is unpublished; Roy presided over the March 2026 meeting. No holder is minted; Roy is carried as a straggler on issue #163
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 171 (Town of Williston): sec. 14-15: the elective treasurer subsection is repealed; the Treasurer serves under the Town Manager
Town of Williston, 2025 Annual Town Report, 'Listing of Town Appointed Officials': Town Treasurer Mary Gratton, term 'Indef'
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Mary Gratton as Williston's Town Treasurer

offices.title: Collector of Delinquent Taxes
offices.org_name: Town of Williston Collector of Delinquent Taxes

sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 171 (Town of Williston): sec. 15(b)(1): the Collector of Delinquent Taxes is appointed by the Selectboard
Town of Williston, 2025 Annual Town Report, 'Listing of Town Appointed Officials': Collector of Delinquent Taxes Erik Wells (the Town Manager), term 'Indef'
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 171 (Town of Williston): sec. 15(b)(5): the Cemetery Commission (up to five members) is appointed by the Selectboard

Town of Williston, Cemetery Commission page: 'There are five Commissioners appointed by the Selectboard to staggered five-year terms' -- Tim Ross (6/30/2027), Hazel Winter (6/30/2028), and Cameron Clark (6/30/2029); the 2030 and 2031 seats are open
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 171 (Town of Williston): sec. 14: the Board of Library Trustees (seven members, staggered five-year terms) is an elective office
Town of Williston, Library Board of Trustees page: 'The seven members serving on this board are elected and serve staggered five-year terms'

Town of Williston, 2025 Annual Town Report: 'Listing of Town and School District Elected Officials' and 'List of Candidates for Town and School Officials to be voted on March 3, 2026': lists Stephen Perkins (2026), Brian Goodwin and Barbara Mieder (2027), Charity Clark (2028), Diane Downer and Karla Karstens (2029), and Shari Westman (2030); the March 3, 2026 ballot listed Stephen J. Perkins as the sole candidate for the five-year seat

Dorothy Alling Memorial Library, Trustee Minutes, June 15, 2026: present -- Charity Clark, Shari Westman, Karla Karstens, Steve Perkins, Diane Downer, Barbara Mieder, and Brian Goodwin, the full seven-member board

Town of Williston, 2025 Annual Town Report: 'Listing of Town and School District Elected Officials' and 'List of Candidates for Town and School Officials to be voted on March 3, 2026': the elected officials listing shows the Champlain Water District representative (Liz Royer, term expiring 2026), and the March 3, 2026 ballot listed Liz Royer as the sole candidate for a three-year term

Town of Williston, Justice of the Peace page ('Current JP's until 1/31/2027'): concurs name-for-name with the certified slate
